title: salvadora persica var. wightiana
intro: Salvadora persica var. wightiana, commonly known as Toothbrush Tree, is a plant species belonging to the family Salvadoraceae. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include oral health and hygiene, as well as its ability to reduce plaque, inflammation, and bad breath. The therapeutic actions of Salvadora persica var. wightiana are attributed to its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which help to soothe and protect the oral mucosa. The bioactive constituents of this plant include salvadoranin, salvadoric acid, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
